# Stevie Wood Recovery

> Family-run car recovery and towing in Edinburgh and the Lothians, open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

- Website: https://steviewoodrecovery.com/
- Phone and WhatsApp: 07934 015448 (+44 7934 015448)
- Base: 14 Hyvot Bank Ave, Gilmerton, Edinburgh EH17 8NJ
- Hours: open 24 hours, every day, including Christmas and New Year
- Average arrival across Edinburgh: about 40 minutes
- Vehicles: cars, vans and 4x4s
- Fully insured

## Services

- Breakdown recovery: we load the vehicle onto the truck and take it home or to a garage
- Towing across Edinburgh and the Lothians
- Jump starts for flat batteries
- Accident recovery
- Wrong fuel recovery: fuel drained and vehicle recovered
- 24 hour emergency call-outs

## Areas covered

Edinburgh City Centre, Leith, Portobello, Morningside, Gilmerton, Liberton, Musselburgh, Dalkeith, Bonnyrigg, Loanhead, Penicuik, the A720 City Bypass, and the rest of Midlothian, East Lothian and West Lothian.
